g.text: Curve pools, Yield Basis as LP
Selling through Curve crvUSD pools where Yield Basis is the LP, mostly BTC, put a net
3.85M is 3.90M sold through the Curve pools minus 0.05M bought through the LEVAMM leg, 3.64M of it through the BTC pools,
most of it between 21:45 and 22:00 UTC. Net crvUSD flow in the five PegKeeper pools per 15 minutes, million crvUSD. Above
zero (blue) is crvUSD bought out of the pools, below zero (vermillion) is crvUSD sold in. Other swaps and liquidity deposits
in gray. Classes assigned per transaction by the pre-registered rules.
Source: Ethereum mainnet logs and archive state via public RPC. Window 2026-11-08 20:00 to 2026-11-09 04:00 UTC. Times in UTC. Shaded band is the
pre-registered flush hour, which missed the actual drop at 21:41 to 21:56. Rules in PREREG_ADDENDUM.md.
